assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Alice uses an isolated browser profile with the synthetic identity and permissions defined for this case
2. And the synthetic catalog uses exact tile titles "T-TRADE", "T-CASH", and "T-REPORT"
3. And T-TRADE requires entity "E-TRADE" and subject "S-VIEW"
4. And T-CASH requires entity "E-CASH" and subject "S-VIEW"
5. And T-REPORT permits entities "E-RR-A" and "E-RR-B" with an empty subject
6. And Alice has no registered portal entity
7. And The isolated browser storage contains the synthetic guest flag
8. When Alice requests opening report tile "T-REPORT" through the portal
9. Then no protected T-REPORT business field is visible in Alice's browser
10. And the effective catalog response contains no T-REPORT entry granted only by the synthetic guest flag
